_note: Destination registry. studio.vice.channels.validate() checks every publication draft against this file and the account the upload token belongs to. Channels share tools, never destinations, branding, analytics or history.

clipcircuit.note: Posts ALL campaign clips, including GTA 6 ones made in the Vice Replay chat (owner, Nov 20).

what-if-arena.note: Separate project. The connected vidIQ account belongs to this channel: never use it for Vice Replay analytics.

vice-replay-es.name: Vice Replay en Español
vice-replay-es.note: Spanish-voice versions of Vice Replay Shorts (rendered every day by studio.ship). Upload: python -m studio.youtube_es. channel_id is filled in after the owner creates the channel and `youtube_es whoami` shows it.

_voice_note: Nov 22 owner: "use the best voice rated" -> Kokoro af_heart (grade A; am_michael was C+). Kokoro grades no Spanish voice, so Spanish stays em_alex until the owner picks.
_shorts_subtitles_note: Nov 22 night, owner: "every posting credit must be used posting or answering comments". Subtitle files cost 400 quota units each and Shorts already have burned-in captions; set true to upload subtitle tracks on Shorts again (long videos always get them).

spanish_winners_only._note: Owner Nov 23 ("Approve next steps"): until Vice Replay en Español has an audience, a Spanish version of an English Short is uploaded only if the English one did well in its first 24 h (views >= max(min_views_24h, median 24 h views of our last 7 days)). Spanish-only Shorts (es_only, no English original) are not affected. studio.spend decides; set on=false to go back to EN+ES for every Short.

_transition_sound_note: Nov 24 owner: didn't like the old noise whoosh between slides. swell (default) | tick | whoosh | none

card_photos._note: Nov 24 owner approved: official screenshots (vetted pool, exact-name first) behind lettering cards in videos; trailer clips stay out

_spanish_pause_note: Owner Nov 26 "DO IT": no Spanish YouTube uploads until Dec 3 (37 views in 12 videos); Spanish versions go to TikTok. Review Dec 3: resume only if the TikTok Spanish numbers or a winner justify it.

auto_publish._note: Owner Nov 26 (Autonomous publishing authorization update): English YouTube Shorts publish automatically at their slot only when studio/approvals.py passes all 10 conditions. Pause: python -m studio.approvals pause "why"; two failed uploads in a row pause it automatically.
